name: Imouto Ijiri ~Futarime~ Boku no Ichiban Daiji na Hi - Akira-chan
original_name: 妹いじり ～ふたりめ～ ボクのいちばん大事な日 晶ちゃん
source:
Today is the most important day for Akira-chan. In order to fulfill the promise given one year ago she gathers thoughts and goes to her brother's room.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-august-2002-ever17-out-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
今天是小晶最重要的日子。为了兑现一年前许下的约定，她整理好思绪，走向哥哥的房间。
